# EVOLVE Apparel

> Western-Canadian outdoor lifestyle apparel. Heavyweight hoodies, tees, caps, and a few things for the trail, made to order and shipped across Canada and the United States. The Evolve Journal publishes researched guides to getting outside in Canada.

EVOLVE Apparel is an online shop at https://evolveapparel.shop. It is the apparel arm of Evolve Eco Blasting and a KR8TIV company. Prices are in CAD. All sales are final, except manufacturing defects reported within 14 days of delivery, which are exchanged or remade. The full policy is at https://evolveapparel.shop/terms/. Contact: 780-915-5471 or kr8tiv@kr8tiv.io.

Markdown copies of these pages live at the same path with a .md extension, for example https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-hot-springs-western-canada.md. They are provided for readers and tools that prefer plain text. They are not advertised on the website.

## Site

- [We don't tame the wild. We belong to it.](https://evolveapparel.shop/about/): Descended from survivors. One of the largest lands on Earth. Work hard, play hard. The story behind EVOLVE.
- [Prairies to peaks, boreal to coast.](https://evolveapparel.shop/): Western-Canadian outdoor lifestyle apparel. Embroidered hoodies, tees and caps, made to order and shipped across Canada. The apparel arm of Evolve Eco Blasting.
- [Field notes.](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/): Getting outside in Western Canada and beyond — where to ski and ride, the best hikes in Alberta and BC, boutique cabins to escape to, and Canada's best parks.
- [Privacy Policy](https://evolveapparel.shop/privacy/): How EVOLVE collects, uses, and protects your information. We only collect what we need to fulfil your order and never sell your data.
- [Shop everything.](https://evolveapparel.shop/shop/): Heavyweight hoodies, tees, flannels, caps and more. Made to order and shipped across Canada and North America. Built for the bush, made for the long haul.
- [Terms & Returns](https://evolveapparel.shop/terms/): EVOLVE terms of sale. All sales are final; we exchange or remake any item with a manufacturing defect. Made to order, shipped across North America.

## Journal

- [Where the Signal Dies: Off-Grid Backcountry Lodges and Huts You Can Ski or Snowshoe Into](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/backcountry-lodges-huts-winter/): Backcountry lodges in BC and huts in Alberta you ski or snowshoe into this winter: 2026 to 2027 prices, access, permits, and avalanche rules.
- [Banff in December: Christmas in the Rockies](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/banff-in-december/): Banff in December means short cold days, a Christmas market to December 13, 2026, Lake Louise skating, and priced Christmas dinners in town.
- [Bear Country Manners: What to Actually Do When You Meet a Grizzly](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/bear-country-manners-grizzly-black-bear-canada/): What to do if you meet a grizzly or black bear in Canada: ID tips, bear spray, bluff charges, food caches, dogs and bikes — Parks Canada–sourced for Alberta & BC trails.
- [The Best Hikes in Alberta and BC: 8 Day Trips and Two Big Ones Worth the Sweat](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-hikes-alberta-bc/): The best hikes in Alberta and BC, with real distances, elevation gain and permit rules for standout day hikes and bigger summer trips.
- [No Mountains Required: The Best Hikes Within Two Hours of Edmonton](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-hikes-near-edmonton/): The best hikes near Edmonton: river valley, parkland and boreal trails close to the city, plus Elk Island and day trips within two hours.
- [Hot Water, Cold Air: Western Canada's Best Natural Hot Springs, Ranked](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-hot-springs-western-canada/): The best hot springs in Western Canada, ranked from the Alaska Highway to Kootenay Lake, with fees, seasons and rules before you soak.
- [The 10 Best National Parks in Canada, Ranked by Someone Who Has Opinions](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-national-parks-canada/): The 10 best national parks in Canada, ranked, with the one thing worth going for in each park and a practical tip for your visit.
- [Deep Wild, Good Sheets: Five Canadian Nature Resorts Worth the Drive or the Floatplane](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-nature-resorts-canada/): The best nature resorts in Canada: wilderness lodges with full comfort, from a fly-in BC archipelago to a Quebec lake in moose country.
- [The 10 Best Places to Stay in Western Canada With a Breathtaking View From Your Room](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-places-to-stay-western-canada-views/): The 10 best places to stay in Western Canada with a view from your room: Rockies lakes, Pacific storms and aurora, with prices and how to get there.
- [First Snow, Best Views: 10 Places in Western Canada That Get Better When the Snow Falls](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-places-western-canada-winter/): The best places to visit in Western Canada in winter: Lake Louise, Abraham Lake's ice bubbles, frozen canyons, the Icefields Parkway, Tofino storms and more.
- [The Best Ski Resorts in Alberta: A Rider's Field Guide to the Big Three](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-ski-resorts-alberta/): The best ski resorts in Alberta: how to ski and ride Sunshine Village, Lake Louise and Marmot Basin, with terrain tips for each mountain.
- [Stand Here: The Ten Most Breathtaking Views in Canada and How to Reach Them](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-views-canada/): The 10 most breathtaking views in Canada and how to reach them, from Moraine Lake in Banff to Virginia Falls, twice the height of Niagara.
- [Ten Boutique Cabins and Lodges in Canada Worth the Drive (or the Floatplane)](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/boutique-cabins-canada/): Ten boutique cabins and lodges in Canada, from a hanging sphere on Vancouver Island to a glass-roofed aurora chalet in the Yukon.
- [Cold and Free: Five Canadian Adventure Sports Worth the Adrenaline](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/canadian-extreme-sports/): Canadian adventure sports the world copies, from heli-skiing where it was invented to year-round Pacific surfing, and how beginners can start.
- [Descended from Survivors: Ten Backcountry Skills the First Canadians Knew and We Forgot](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/first-canadians-survival-skills/): Survival skills of Canada's first peoples: how Indigenous knowledge made life at minus forty possible, and how settlers survived by learning it.
- [First Hole: A Beginner's Field Guide to Ice Fishing in Alberta](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/ice-fishing-alberta/): Ice fishing in Alberta for beginners: licence costs, safe ice thickness, the rules, stocked trout ponds near Edmonton and Calgary, gear and what to wear.
- [Learning to Climb in Canada: Where to Start Mountaineering Without Getting in Over Your Head](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/learn-to-mountaineer-canada/): How to learn mountaineering in Canada: courses, guides and the right order to go from your first scramble to a glaciated summit.
- [Pack Light, Eat Smart: The Beginner's Hike-Packing Kit People Always Get Wrong](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/lightweight-hike-packing-kit/): A lightweight hiking packing list: the Ten Essentials, trail food math and the small items people forget, for day hikes and multi-day trips.
- [Chasing Green: Where to See the Northern Lights in Alberta and Western Canada](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/northern-lights-alberta-western-canada/): Where to see the northern lights in Alberta and Western Canada: KP index and aurora forecasts, best months, dark-sky parks, camera settings and cold tips.
- [Build Your Own Off-Grid Escape: Cheap Land, Solar, and a Wood-Fired Soak Near Canada's Best Parks](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/off-grid-cabin-canada/): How to build an off-grid cabin in Canada: affordable land near great parks, the permit rules nobody warns you about, and the off-grid tech.
- [The Powder Highway: A Road Trip Through BC's Deepest Snow](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/powder-highway-bc/): Powder Highway BC for 2026 to 2027: eight Kootenay resorts, posted opening dates, pass rules, Rogers Pass, and the drive from Calgary or Edmonton.
- [The Most Romantic Winter Getaways in Alberta](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/romantic-winter-getaways-alberta/): Romantic getaways Alberta winter: glass cabins, domes, lake lodges and private wood-fired tubs you can drive to. Rates checked late November 2026.
- [The Long Haul: Canada's Greatest Road Trips, With the Gas Stations Nobody Warns You About](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/the-long-haul-canada-road-trips/): Six iconic Canadian road trips—Icefields Parkway, Alaska Highway, Stewart-Cassiar, Dempster, Cowboy Trail, and Trans-Labrador—plus every fuel gap.
- [Vancouver Island, End to End: Ten Places Worth the Ferry](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/vancouver-island-places/): The best places on Vancouver Island beyond Tofino, from old-growth giants and Victoria to an orca strait and the wild north tip.
- [Minus Thirty and Wide Open: Western Canada's Best Winter Adventures](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/western-canada-winter-adventures/): Western Canada's best winter adventures for 2026-27: ten festivals, icewalks, and skating trails across BC, the Prairies, and the North, in date order.
